steps.title: Read the client's onboarding form, brand files and proof files
guidance: When the client sent the month's platform exports, call social.report on them. The report cites the figure refs it returns, never a figure of its own.
steps.produces: A list of channels, audience, competitors, banned words and topics, and the claims the client can prove with a file.

steps.title: Ask what is still unclear, one topic at a time
guidance: Ask at most five rounds, one topic per round, most important first, then use the defaults.
steps.produces: Answers, or the defaults the owner accepts.

steps.title: Write the brand voice sheet and content pillars
steps.produces: A voice sheet and pillars in fixed slots.

steps.title: You approve the voice sheet and pillars
steps.produces: The approved voice sheet every later draft follows.

steps.title: Fill topics and hooks into the calendar slots code made
guidance: Give each slot code made one topic, one pillar and one hook. Never add, move or date a slot: code owns the dates.
steps.produces: A month of post slots, each with a topic, a pillar and a hook.

steps.title: Draft each post for each channel, and reply drafts when the offer includes them
steps.produces: Captions, alt text and hashtags per channel, and reply drafts.

steps.title: Write briefs for pictures, video and creator-style ads
steps.produces: Briefs with beats from hook to call to action. Generation waits until you see the cost from code.

steps.title: Run the code checks, then the yes or no judge
steps.produces: Each draft marked ready, or blocked with the reason and the rule it rests on.

steps.title: You approve each draft, then your client approves it through a share link
steps.produces: Drafts approved for their exact text.

steps.title: Post or schedule the approved drafts, approving each post
steps.produces: Posts that went out, each one a journal entry, or a calendar file you import into your own tool.

steps.title: Your client uploads the platform exports for the month
steps.produces: The exports, kept as the order files.

steps.title: Compute the report figures from the exports, each with a receipt
steps.produces: Figures in whole numbers with receipts naming the file, the rows and the columns.

steps.title: Write the report narrative from the receipts
guidance: Cite each figure as a figure part with its reference from social.report. Write no figure, rate or change of your own in the words.
steps.produces: A short narrative that cites receipts and never a figure of its own.

steps.title: You approve the report; the invoice comes from the books
steps.produces: The report for the client and the invoice for the month.
